summary: Stop nex-core-local postinst from failing ISO installs when AppArmor looks enabled but the target cannot reload profiles. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Installer packaging fix only; operator install steps are unchanged.

api.reason: API impact: none. Maintainer scripts only.

state.reason: Package maintainer scripts; no new Controller or Core durable state.

verification.method: Matched installer log (apparmor_parser /proc/mounts warning then postinst exit 1) to postinst set -e reload. Gate now requires non-chroot (/ vs /proc/1/root) and existing /sys/kernel/security/apparmor/.load. Fixed CI flake where chmod 0444 still looked writable as root. sh -n on postinst/prerm; test_storage_packaging passed.
